messages.subject: RE: Project Vertex - Patent Licence Agreement (draft v1)
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Our mark-up attached (v2). The main moves: upfront to £7.5m and payable within 5 business days; the Licensor's retained rights broadened to allow licensing outside the Field; liability cap reduced to 6 months' receipts; and the cure period tightened to 30 days. Most of the rest is light-touch. Call me when you've digested it.

Rachel

messages.subject: FW: Project Vertex - Patent Licence Agreement (draft v1)
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah, Tom,

Hargrove's v2 in. The retained-rights expansion is the one to push back on hard - "outside the Field" is far too broad and could let Calbryn license a competitor in an adjacent indication. I'd also resist the 6-month liability cap. The upfront we can probably split the difference on. I'll prepare v3 - thoughts welcome before I turn it.

James

messages.subject: RE: Project Vertex - Patent Licence Agreement (draft v1)
messages.plaintextBody:
Agreed on retained rights - reject outright. Push cap back to 12 months but I'll settle at 9 if needed. Offer £6.5m on the upfront to close it. Keep the cure period at 45. Go ahead and turn v3.

Sarah
